#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Set script to exit on any error
set -e

# Get current directory name for the archive
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Excluding node_modules and .git directories..."

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

echo "Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Archive contents:"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
if [ $(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | wc -l) -gt 20 ]; then
    echo "... and $(($(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | wc -l) - 20)) more files"
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Includes pre-deployment validation of environment variables

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Function to validate environment variables from .env.test
validate_env() {
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    # Read .env.test file and check each variable has a value
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (everything before the first =)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if the variable is set in the environment
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$var_name' is not set"
            exit 1
        fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Includes pre-deployment validation of environment variables
# Sends config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Function to validate environment variables from .env.test
validate_env() {
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    # Read .env.test file and check each variable has a value
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (everything before the first =)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if the variable is set in the environment
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$var_name' is not set"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "✓ $var_name is set"
    done < .env.test
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
}

# Function to send .env.test contents to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found for config submission"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance..."
    
    # Read .env.test and convert to JSON
    # Parse KEY=VALUE pairs into JSON object
    json_payload="{"
    first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no key
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma separator for subsequent entries
        if [[ $first == true ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload="$json_payload,"
        fi
        
        # Escape quotes and backslashes in value for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        
        # Add to JSON payload
        json_payload="$json_payload\"\\\"$key\\\"\":\"\\\"$escaped_value\\\"\""
    done < .env.test
    
    json_payload="$json_payload}"
    
    # Send POST request to orchestrator
    response=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" || echo "Connection failed")
    
    # Extract HTTP status code
    http_status="${response: -3}"
    response_body="${response:0:-3}"
    
    if [[ "$http_status" != "2"* ]]; then
        echo "Error: Failed to send config to orchestrator. HTTP status: $http_status"
        echo "Response: $response_body"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator"
}

# Get the current directory name for the archive
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Run pre-deployment validation
validate_env

# Send config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git

    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="*.log" \
    --exclude="deploy.sh" \
    .

SCRIPT_NAME="deploy.sh"

# Default archive name with timestamp

ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Check if we're in a git repository to get version info, otherwise use timestamp
if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty)
else
    VERSION=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
fi

ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${VERSION}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Excluding node_modules and .git directories..."

    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    .

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    
    # Show archive contents
    echo ""
    echo "Archive contents:"
    tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
    
    if [ $(tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | wc -l) -gt 20 ]; then
        echo "... and more files"
    fi
    
    # Show archive size
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo "Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
else
    echo "Error creating archive!"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Validates required environment variables from .env.test

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
echo "=== Pre-deployment Validation ==="
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Loading environment variables from .env.test"
    # Source the .env.test file to load variables
    # Using export to make them available to sub-shells
    set -a
    source .env.test
    set +a
    
    # Check each variable from .env.test for non-empty values
    MISSING_VARS=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value _; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$key" && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            # Remove quotes if present
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^["'\''"]*//;s/["'\''"]*$//')
            
            # Check if value is empty after removing quotes
            if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == *"'"* || "$value" == *'\"'* ]]; then
                echo "❌ Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
                MISSING_VARS=$((MISSING_VARS + 1))
            else
                echo "✅ Environment variable '$key' is set"
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    if [ $MISSING_VARS -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Pre-deployment validation failed: $MISSING_VARS required environment variable(s) are missing or empty"
        echo "Please set these variables in your .env.test file or export them in your shell"
        exit 1
    else
        echo ""
        echo "✅ All required environment variables are set"
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
    echo "   Make sure all required environment variables are set manually."
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Creating Release Archive ==="
# Check if we're in a git repository to get version info, otherwise use timestamp
if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty)
else
    VERSION=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
fi

ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${VERSION}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Excluding node_modules and .git directories..."

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    .

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    
    # Show archive contents
    echo ""
    echo "Archive contents:"
    tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | head -20
    
    if [ $(tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | wc -l) -gt 20 ]; then
        echo "... and more files"
    fi
    
    # Show archive size
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo "Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
else
    echo "Error creating archive!"
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "Deployment preparation complete!"

if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Loading environment variables from .env.test"

    # Using export to make them available to sub-shells
    set -a
    source .env.test
    set +a
    
    # Check each variable from .env.test for non-empty values
    MISSING_VARS=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value _; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$key" && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            # Remove quotes if present
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^["'\''"]*//;s/["'\''"]*$//')
            
            # Check if value is empty after removing quotes
            if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == *"'"* || "$value" == *'\"'* ]]; then
                echo "❌ Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
                MISSING_VARS=$((MISSING_VARS + 1))
            else
                echo "✅ Environment variable '$key' is set"
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    if [ $MISSING_VARS -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Pre-deployment validation failed: $MISSING_VARS required environment variable(s) are missing or empty"

        exit 1

    VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty)

    VERSION=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)

    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \

    .

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Check if tar is available
if ! command -v tar &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: tar command not found. Please install tar."
    exit 1
fi

# Get current directory name for the archive
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="*.log" \
    --exclude="*.tmp" \
    --exclude=".env" \
    --exclude="deploy.sh" \
    .

# Check if the command was successful
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive excluding node_modules and .git

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables from .env.test
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Check if the environment variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            exit 1
        fi
    done < .env.test
    echo "Environment variable validation passed."
    
    # Send .env.test contents to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Read .env.test and convert to JSON
    json_payload="{"
    first=true
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Add comma separator for JSON (except for first item)
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload+=","
        fi
        
        # Escape quotes and add to JSON payload
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < .env.test
    json_payload+="}"
    
    # POST JSON to deployment orchestrator

    http_status=${response: -3}
    response_body=${response:0:-3}
    
    if [ "$http_status" -eq 200 ]; then
        echo "Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator."
    else
        echo "Warning: Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator. HTTP Status: $http_status"
        echo "Response: $response_body"
        # Continue with deployment despite failure to send config
    fi
else
    echo ".env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation and config submission."
fi

ARCHIVE_NAME="${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz"

rsync -av --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.DS_Store' . "$RELEASE_NAME/"

rm -rf "$RELEASE_NAME"
